title.text: TEMS — the Ellinikon music studio · site design v1

concept.text: Concept: 'Two takes'. The logo ships in a black and a white version, so the site alternates hard black and paper-white bands. Heavy condensed type echoes the TEMS mark, mono labels read like tape-box and track-sheet notes, one signal-orange accent is the REC light. Structure follows blackbirdstudio.com. No booking: every CTA leads to the interest form.

images.text: Images: studio photos are the client's (control room, live room, instrument room, mic locker, lounge, building). Still stand-ins from the Nevma Music design: release covers (Home records grid, Clients wall). Still missing: team portraits, floor plan. The building photo shows a 'THE SOUND LAB' sign; needs a TEMS version. NEVMA links point to #nevma-music-site until the domain is confirmed.
